title: Phase gate policies
description: How strict each phase gate is (EE-156): per phase, the gate items with what proves each and how its strength is measured on the evidence levels (adapted from GRADE), and named presets that set each item's minimum level and boundary (fail-closed refuses the phase change, fail-open passes and names the shortfall as an open risk). Every threshold is an unvalidated prior.

levels.description: The evidence levels from weakest to strongest

count_levels.description: For counted evidence, the minimum count that reaches each level above very low

phases.description: Keyed by phase id, as in packages/naive/src/phases/<id>/phase.json

record.description: The record type that proves it, or null when a person's act proves it

kind.description: count: counted evidence mapped by count_levels; grade: the GRADE level of the record's cited evidence; coverage: share of open items a plan names; authority: a person's act

of.description: What is counted, for kind count

requires.description: Fields the record must fill before its evidence is scored

presets.description: Named policies, keyed by preset id; each maps every item id to its minimum level and boundary
